- Tue Mar 21, 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Wed Mar 22, 9:00-10:00 AM PT

If those don't work, feel free to pick via my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/neha-private-vpc-review

1) Requirements & traffic profile (10m)
2) Topology options: VPC peering vs PrivateLink vs transit (20m)
3) KMS/HSM patterns & audit logs (15m)
4) Implementation timeline & next steps (15m)

Thanks - looking forward to getting this on the calendar.
